chapter: Trio years, the Sands and Armstrong recollections
title: Trio years, the Frolic and the Catskills
summary: Back to a trio; the Frolic in 1955 and the Catskills in 1956-57.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: You weren't able to keep the band together after that? In other words, there were no jobs in the nightclubs then for you to keep that eight piece group together.
Not that eight piece group; no.
So what did you do? Is that when you broke back down to a trio?
That's when I went down
to a trio.
Now this was getting close to the time that I met you.
Yeah, you met me in '55, didn't you?
'55. So when you were working the Frolic--
I was working the Frolic in '55.
The Frolic you were in and what was the other--the Sands doesn't come until later, does it?
Part of the time I was working upstate in the Catskills.
I thought you didn't work the Catskills until more recent years.
I worked there the first time in '57--'56 and '57.
Yeah, that's what I thought.
That's the time some guy came over and was talking about Trent's band
Yeah? Who was that?
Some guy on the radio station, something in Boston, public network. He said Snub Mosley is the fastest slide in the west.
You better believe it.
Did you get to make any of the soundings or anything like that?
I made one.
